method_notes.eligibility: Weight independent: percentile rule on the balls measure per format and role (batter balls faced, bowler legal balls), recomputed from the data.
method_notes.format_scores: Independent per format; z-score within the format's eligible pool.
method_notes.combined: Only BOTH_FORMATS_VALID players; others NULL with an explicit status.
method_notes.degenerate: 100:0 and 0:100 use the same combined population as every other configuration, so their ranks equal the IPL or T20I z-score ranks within that population.

adjusted_estimate.note: Weights renormalised over the eligible formats of each player. Not a combined score, not used in the default ranking, and not comparable across single-format and two-format players.
